gloss: smelling of the sea; having a briny, seaweed-like odor

definitions.gloss: smelling of the sea; having a briny, fishy, or seaweed-like odor
definitions.explanation: Describing the characteristic smell of a rocky seashore — a mix of salt water, seaweed, and marine life. Can be either evocative (nostalgia for the coast) or unpleasant depending on context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{磯臭|いそくさ}い。
examples.english: It smells briny near the harbor.

examples.japanese: {磯臭|いそくさ}い⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いて→吹く：02445_fuku⟧きた。

⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{磯臭|いそくさ}く⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦シャワー→シャワー：04503_shawaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びた→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧。
examples.english: After getting out of the sea my body smelled briny, so I took a shower right away.

notes:
A compound adjective from ⟦{磯|いそ}→磯：05389_iso⟧ (rocky shore, seashore) + ⟦{臭|くさ}い→臭い：01133_kusai⟧ (smelling of, -smelling). The ⟦{磯|いそ}→磯：05389_iso⟧ specifically refers to rocky coastline as opposed to sandy beaches, so the smell is associated with seaweed, tide pools, and exposed marine life.

USAGE:
The word can be neutral or slightly negative. For some it evokes pleasant seaside memories; for others it describes an unwanted fishy smell. The suffix ～⟦{臭|くさ}い→臭い：01133_kusai⟧ is productive in Japanese: {汗臭|あせくさ}い (sweaty-smelling), {酒臭|さけくさ}い (reeking of alcohol), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {磯臭|いそくさ}い⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ — sea-scented wind
- {磯臭|いそくさ}い⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧ — briny smell
- ⟦{磯|いそ}→磯：05389_iso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧ — scent of the shore (more poetic/positive)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{生臭|なまぐさ}い→生臭い：06822_namagusai⟧ — smelling of raw fish, fishy (stronger; more unpleasant)
- ⟦{潮|しお}→潮：13369_shio⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧ — scent of the sea breeze (poetic; always positive)
- {魚臭|さかなくさ}い — smelling of fish (specifically fish, not the general shore smell)
